# References

One file per task (`<TASK-ID>.md`), written by the model doing the task (see `05-RESEARCH-PROTOCOL.md`). The master list below was collected with TinyFish on 2026-11-01.

- F1 flow-vis paint: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/testing-explained-rob-smedley-on-flow-vis.7nU2VePGlVrhIGa8wgCoLE
